d: Flavio Bolsonaro, the loser of the Brazilian presidential election, has fled the country. Bolsonaro junior has arrived in Miami, in the US state of Florida, to seek refuge. Firstpost looks at Flavio Bolsonaro's escape from Brazil, where he is being investigated over several corruption scandals. Gursshheenkaur Gahllen explains the reason behind Bolsonaro's departure, and the reactions from US president Donald Trump, Brazilian president Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, and the Brazilian public.
